io.milvus.orm.iterator

Class SearchIterator

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.orm.iterator.SearchIterator

  • public class SearchIterator
extends Object
    Iterator that paginates through the results of a vector search.

    The iterator performs the initial search on construction and then probes with a growing radius window, using the radius/range_filter search parameters, until it has collected a batch of results. Already returned rows are tracked through their primary keys and excluded from subsequent probes, so each call to next() returns the next batchSize rows without duplication.

    Results are internally staged in an IteratorCache. The iterator supports a limit (topK); when the limit is reached, next() returns an empty list.

    • Method Detail

      • next

        public List<QueryResultsWrapper.RowRecord> next()
        Returns the next batch of search results.

        The returned list contains up to batchSize rows. When the configured limit (topK) is reached, or the iterator was not initialized, an empty list is returned. If the cached page is not sufficient, the iterator probes with a widened radius window to fill the batch.

        Returns:
        the next batch of rows, or an empty list if the iteration is finished

      • close

        public void close()
        Releases the cached results and clears the internal filtered-ID list of the iterator.
